g.title: ENERGY008_SOLVER
g.text: Stoichiometry → property / PFR / flash → S-209 recycle → closure / export

g.title: START
g.text: Load versioned inputs / case ID / design scenario

g.title: SCHEMA
g.text: Check source approvals, data status, bounds and completeness

g.title: BDATA
g.text: List missing EOS pairs, kinetics, feed assays, VLE, vendor maps
No default values; dependent solver not called

g.title: STOICH
g.text: Exact rank, null-space, C/H/O invariants; reject dependent R-03

g.title: BEXT
g.text: Keep signed residual, identify species / reaction / case

g.title: INIT
g.text: S-209 component vector seed (zero is numerical seed only)
Store F-scale per species and iteration log

g.title: FRONT
g.text: CO2 conditioning component balances + K-101 state
W-201 quality + ELY Faraday/vendor map + D-201/K-201
Reject out-of-map or crossover / quality-invalid states

g.title: MIX
g.text: Combine fresh CO2 + H2 + S-209 recycle
Evaluate feed composition, enthalpy and valid preheat state

g.title: EOS
g.text: EOS roots + phase stability + phi_i + fugacity
Require all active kij and phase/temperature/pressure validity

g.title: EPROP
g.text: Do not assume kij=0 or ideal gas; preserve last valid state

g.title: KIN
g.text: Source-matched LHHW form and original pressure basis
Solve site fractions; check [0,1], site sums and rate units

g.title: EKIN
g.text: Catalyst or parameter mismatch; no generic kinetic substitution

g.title: PFR
g.text: Ergun only with geometry / transport inputs

g.title: EPFR
g.text: Record axial location, local residuals and rejected step

g.title: FLASH
g.text: Energy balance + stability / phase fraction check

g.title: EFLASH
g.text: Do not force vapour fraction or invent liquid split

g.title: SPLIT
g.text: Solve purge from measured inert ingress + approved loop cap
Compress recycle K-301 using valid map; calculate new S-209 vector

g.title: RESID
g.text: Also calculate component, elemental and pressure residuals

g.title: CONV
g.text: and all unit / bounds checks pass?

g.title: DIST
g.text: Only if Wilson/NRTL data, pressure, feed and product basis valid
Solve material + equilibrium + summation + energy equations

g.title: RELAX
g.text: Retain raw/mapped/relaxed vector and every residual
λ changes only under logged recovery rule

g.title: RETRY
g.text: Reduce λ or use approved continuation from last admissible point
Optional Anderson/Newton only in separately tested configuration

g.title: EREC
g.text: Status FAILED; preserve last iterate; suppress converged stream export

g.title: EMESH
g.text: Preserve tray/stage diagnostics; no arbitrary reflux or pressure change

g.title: CLOSURE
g.text: Re-run every unit at accepted tear vector
Component / mass / C-H-O / energy / quality / bounds
No balancing stream and no heat-reaction double count

g.title: ECL
g.text: FAIL: closure / entropy / exergy / sizing code
Keep failed status and missing terms; no KPI promotion

g.title: EXPORT
g.text: Version + residuals + iterations + uncertainty + audit trail
Mark each result CALCULATED / REFERENCE_ONLY / BLOCKED
